decisive_items: TSC1 gene mutation (15 exon c.1690 G > T, p.E564*)
response.rationale: TSC1 mutation plus classic TSC features (rhabdomyoma, hypopigmented macules, tubers) confirm Tuberous Sclerosis Complex; the posterior fossa mass is a manifestation, not a separate diagnosis.

rejected.why: Cardiac rhabdomyoma is a TSC feature, not the overall diagnosis.
Histopathology lacks rhabdoid morphology and genetic evidence points to TSC.
Depigmented spots are hypopigmented, not melanocytic; no melanosis features.
SEGA is a possible tumor in TSC but the underlying syndrome is TSC, and location is atypical.
